entries.name: Gemma-2-2B-it
entries.notes: Card declares English only; Korean not claimed. google/gemma-2-2b-it is gated (HTTP 401); architecture read from the unsloth/gemma-2-2b-it re-upload, corroborated field-for-field by a second independent re-upload (unsloth/gemma-2-2b-it-bnb-4bit), and checksummed against the official repo's own safetensors parameter total (2,614,341,888), which recomputation matches to <0.1%. tie_embeddings=true is deliberate and must NOT be 'corrected' from the mirror: the unsloth config.json says tie_word_embeddings=false, but its own checkpoint carries no lm_head tensor (single-file safetensors header: 288 tensors, one model.embed_tokens.weight of [256000, 2304]), and the parameter arithmetic only closes at 2,614,341,888 when the output head is tied - untied would add a further 589,824,000. The bnb-4bit re-upload omits the flag entirely, which defaults to tied. Gemma 2 alternates sliding-window (4096) and global attention; a uniform KV-cache formula overestimates its cache at long context.

entries.name: Gemma-3-4B-it
entries.notes: Card claims 140+ languages; multilingual, not Korean-specialised. google/gemma-3-4b-it is gated (HTTP 401); architecture read from the unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it re-upload, corroborated field-for-field by a second independent re-upload (unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it-bnb-4bit), and checksummed against the official repo's own safetensors parameter total (4,300,079,472), which recomputation matches to <0.1%. Text tower only: params_b is the text-tower total 3,883,213,440; the official checkpoint total (4,300,079,472) additionally includes the 416,866,032-param SigLIP vision encoder that a text-only llama.cpp run does not load. Matches text-only GGUF size. tie_embeddings=true is deliberate and must NOT be 'corrected' from the mirror: the unsloth config.json says tie_word_embeddings=false, but its model.safetensors.index.json weight_map contains no lm_head entry, and the text-tower arithmetic only closes at 3,883,213,440 when the output head is tied - untied would add a further 671,252,480. The bnb-4bit re-upload omits the flag entirely, which defaults to tied. Gemma 3 interleaves 5 local (1024-token sliding-window) layers per global layer; a uniform KV-cache formula overestimates its cache at long context.
